Name: TID_MISSION_4_0_OBJECTIVE
Text: Labycore customs seized machine parts that I was shipping in! If you get my shipment back, I'll let you keep some of the best ingredients.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_0_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks! Here you go, your share of the ingredients as agreed. Craft something for yourself?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_0_TASK_0
Text: Collect shipment

Name: TID_MISSION_4_0
Text: Nuts & Bolts

Name: TID_MISSION_4_1_OBJECTIVE
Text: Hmm... Seems that a lot of my merchandise ended up in the pockets of those corrupt Labycore Security. How about you reclaim those too?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_1_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Excellent work! Here's your reward.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_1_TASK_0
Text: Get Package from Trooper

Name: TID_MISSION_4_1_TASK_1
Text: Get package from Officer

Name: TID_MISSION_4_2_OBJECTIVE
Text: You showed a certain gleeful proficiency in taking out those LabSec baddies. How about thinning them out some more? I have another shipment coming in.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_2_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Wow, you really showed them! Maybe you should talk to Tollman. I hear he's looking for people who can take on Labycore.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_2_TASK_0
Text: Take Out Security

Name: TID_MISSION_4_1
Text: Pickpocket

Name: TID_MISSION_4_2
Text: Toll Free

Name: TID_MISSION_4_3_OBJECTIVE
Text: We can't make any honest profit with the corrupt Customs breathing down our necks. With your particular skills, I know you can help us!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_3_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Fantastic! It'll be a while before they get their ledgers back in order.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_3_TASK_0
Text: Take out Chief Inspector

Name: TID_MISSION_4_3
Text: Chief Inspector

Name: TID_MISSION_4_4_OBJECTIVE
Text: TROLL is a dangerous Labycore guardian robot. It's hunkered down on the pier, and we're not sure if it's active or not. Care to check it out?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_4_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That was a fantastic show! We all had drinks and popcorn and throughly enjoyed ourselves.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_4_TASK_0
Text: Seek and Destroy the Troll

Name: TID_MISSION_4_4
Text: Troll's Lair

Name: TID_MISSION_4_5_OBJECTIVE
Text: Where did those massive crabs come from? And more importantly, who could stop them from snapping mooring lines and destroying our shipping?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_5_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Wow, that's a nice catch! We're going to have a real shoreman's feast tonight!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_5_TASK_0
Text: Hunt crabs

Name: TID_MISSION_4_5
Text: Crayfish Party

Name: TID_MISSION_4_6_OBJECTIVE
Text: I don't know what vile toxins Labycore has been dumping at our shores. You've seen the green guys right? I heard it's contagious too.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_6_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Ok, I think that's enough disease control for now.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_6_TASK_0
Text: Reduce infection threat

Name: TID_MISSION_4_6
Text: Infected

Name: TID_MISSION_4_7_OBJECTIVE
Text: Piggy Bob and his pigs have taken over one of our warehouses!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_7_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: There'll be a barbeque tonight! Yessir.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_7_TASK_0
Text: Kill Piggy Bob

Name: TID_MISSION_4_7
Text: Got Bacon?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_8_OBJECTIVE
Text: I wonder what's going on at the super secret research lab! Trucks have been coming in day and night. Look into it, would you? I'll make it worth your while.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_8_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Tollman: Ok, here we are. I'll leave the approach to you - either sneak in or attack head-on.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_8_TASK_0
Text: Report to Tollman

Name: TID_MISSION_4_8
Text: I Spy

Name: TID_MISSION_4_9_OBJECTIVE
Text: > Tollman: Well, what are you waiting for? I need some information!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_9_TALK_TASK_0
Text: This is our newest marketing research study. By using subliminal messages, we can get ordinary housewives to fight to death over a cleaning product! Amazing, isn't it?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_9_TALK_TASK_1
Text: Now, this test setup should be particularly interesting to you kids in the group. We're finding out if video games REALLY desensitize people to violence. Great stuff, right?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_9_TALK_TASK_2
Text: Welcome, dear visitors! Here at Eureka Science Center we're researching new technologies that will improve your lives. Go right in and find out about our current research projects!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_9_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: > Tollman: Holy darn!! I knew the Labycore were up to no good, but I had no idea...

Name: TID_MISSION_4_9_TASK_0
Text: Examine Eureka

Name: TID_MISSION_4_9_TASK_1
Text: Investigate Eureka

Name: TID_MISSION_4_9_TASK_2
Text: Discover Eureka

Name: TID_MISSION_4_9
Text: Guided Tour

Name: TID_MISSION_4_10_OBJECTIVE
Text: With the guns we can get with these coupons, we'll finally be able to defend ourselves! Listen, I need you to tell this to a friend of mine. You like beaches, right?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_10_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Yes...I'm Ron.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_10_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Discounted guns sounds great, but I'm more worried about the stuff that's going on at Eureka Research. The people you saved were abducted from this refugee camp!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_10_TASK_0
Text: Find Ron

Name: TID_MISSION_4_10
Text: Beach Party

Name: TID_MISSION_4_11_OBJECTIVE
Text: There's an automated tank running amok! I sent my best hunters to take it out, but they peed their pants. Maybe you have more guts?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_11_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Cheers mate! You're an inspiration to all us refugees.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_11
Text: Eliminate Tankinator

Name: TID_MISSION_4_12_OBJECTIVE
Text: You're shaping up to be a real hero of the people! I know a damsel in distress who could really use a champion right now.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_12_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Hi honey, I'll get right to business. The Eastern Mob runs a slave girl operation on this island. Every week they trick more girls to come and put them in chains.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_12
Text: Club Night

Name: TID_MISSION_4_13_OBJECTIVE
Text: Friendly Matches against other freedom fighters is a great way to practice your fighting skills. If you win, you get a special prize!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_13_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice moves. I won't bet against you next time.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_13_TASK_0
Text: Win a Friendly Match

Name: TID_MISSION_4_13
Text: Friendly Match

Name: TID_MISSION_4_14_OBJECTIVE
Text: Hey, the ferry is about to leave for Achilles Island. Want a free ride? All you have to do is check up on my friend there.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_14_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good to see a friendly face. This island was getting dangerous!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_14_TASK_0
Text: Speak to Flux

Name: TID_MISSION_4_14
Text: Travel To Achilles

Name: TID_MISSION_4_15_OBJECTIVE
Text: Hey, you look like you can fight! We're missing a contestant in tonight's card. Step in the arena if you have what it takes! Defeat any other freedom fighter in the arena for cash and plans for special weapon.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_15_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Here's your purse money, and something else: a tip from a veteran.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_15_TASK_0
Text: Defeat an opponent

Name: TID_MISSION_4_15
Text: Challenge Yourself

Name: TID_MISSION_4_16
Text: Unfair Advantage

Name: TID_MISSION_4_16_OBJECTIVE
Text: This is not exactly a fair sport with weight classes and such. Kit yourself with the best weapons and you'll have a much better chance of winning.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_16_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You sure put a nasty blade on that knife.\n\nRemember, we need undercard fighters every day.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_17_OBJECTIVE
Text: I heard an explosion coming from Anchorage block. Go check it out!\n\nAfter that report to Alton. He wants to see you.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_17_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Labycore Security? That means these documents must be something special. Great job!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_17_TASK_0
Text: Grab Documents

Name: TID_MISSION_4_17
Text: Unusual Activity

Name: TID_MISSION_4_18_OBJECTIVE
Text: My friend Raul went to clear out our stash at the Storehouse, but he's taking mighty long. Care to go check on him?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_18_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: So they confiscated everything? We have to get our stuff back somehow.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_18_TASK_0
Text: Find Raul

Name: TID_MISSION_4_18
Text: The Stash

Name: TID_MISSION_4_19_OBJECTIVE
Text: I hear Labycore have left vehicle microcontrollers lying out in the open. Those chips are worth a fortune! Interested?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_19_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Nice work <PLAYER_NAME>. Here, we'll pay back in kind.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_19_TASK_0
Text: Eliminate troopers

Name: TID_MISSION_4_19_TASK_1
Text: Get the chips

Name: TID_MISSION_4_19
Text: Car Jacking

Name: TID_MISSION_4_20_OBJECTIVE
Text: Man, that was awesome! You need to tell our shift manager Alton about this.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_20_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: You are safe for now. This block is controlled by the Resistance. Welcome to the Pirate Bay.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_20_TASK_0
Text: Talk to Alton

Name: TID_MISSION_4_20
Text: On The Dock

Name: TID_MISSION_4_21
Text: Da Capo Al Fine

Name: TID_MISSION_4_21_OBJECTIVE
Text: Don Wang is a capo who united Dawnbreak's Sicilian and Asian gangs under one organization. Kill him and you take out two bosses with one stone.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_21_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Amazing job, <PLAYER_NAME>! Don Wang is facing the music now.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_21_TASK_0
Text: Get Capo's Keycard

Name: TID_MISSION_4_21_TASK_1
Text: Liquidate Don Wang

Name: TID_MISSION_4_22_OBJECTIVE
Text: Even though you liquidated Kingpin, we seem to have another case on our hands. One of our Docker informants disappeared. Go check out his crib!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_22_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: That's just sick! A killing room like you described means we're dealing with real professionals. No wonder they never left a trace before.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_22
Text: No Trace

Name: TID_MISSION_4_22_TASK_0
Text: Find evidence about real boss

Name: TID_MISSION_4_23_OBJECTIVE
Text: The killers left a package that tipped us of their next target. Get over there quick and see if you can't catch them red handed!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_23_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: So Don Wang is the man behind all these contract killings. His base is a regular hit factory, and I want you to crash the party.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_23
Text: Killing You, Killing Me

Name: TID_MISSION_4_23_TASK_0
Text: Catch hitmen

Name: TID_MISSION_4_23_TALK_TASK_1
Text: Yeah... I was trying to con Don Wang cause he stole my girlfriend. Never thought he'd put a hit on me!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_23_TASK_1
Text: Gather information

Name: TID_MISSION_4_18_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Hey ese. Customs agents everywhere! Tell Javier that they have confiscated everything.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_24_OBJECTIVE
Text: I just know that General Adama has survived this thing.. whatever this is. He's ex-military, you know. Find him and get a word to him that we are still alive.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_4_24_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: WOW, easy there, great to see a friendly face! Or a face, that is to say, not some lump of rotting meat. So Angelin sent you and she is still alive. That's great news!\n

Name: TID_MISSION_4_24_TASK_0
Text: Find General Adama

Name: TID_MISSION_4_24
Text: Still alive

Name: TID_MISSION_4_25_OBJECTIVE
Text: We still have a radio here so we could keep contact with other survivors, but we are running out of energy. There are still some laying about in the area, bring me all you can find.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_4_25_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Great, this will keep us going.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_4_25_TASK_0
Text: Find energy coupons

Name: TID_MISSION_4_25
Text: Running out

Name: TID_MISSION_4_26
Text: The Quartermaster

Name: TID_MISSION_4_26_OBJECTIVE
Text: You should talk to our quartermaster, he too needs someone who can survive a trip outside.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_4_26_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Oh, there you are! General Adama told me to expect you .\n

Name: TID_MISSION_4_26_TASK_0
Text: Talk to the Quartermaster

Name: TID_MISSION_4_27_OBJECTIVE
Text: We'll have to block these windows by nightfall, otherwise we'll never survive another attack. Find some boards or something we can use to reinforce this place.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_4_27_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Good work, thanks! Before you go, here is something I thought you might find useful.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_4_27_TASK_0
Text: Find blocking material

Name: TID_MISSION_4_27
Text: Reinforce the stronghold

Name: TID_MISSION_4_28_OBJECTIVE
Text: General Adama was looking for you, you should go speak to him.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_28_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I was looking for you, good that you're here.\n

Name: TID_MISSION_4_28_TASK_0
Text: Talk to General Adama

Name: TID_MISSION_4_28
Text: Search General Adama

Name: TID_MISSION_4_29_OBJECTIVE
Text: (You should probably deliver the bad news to General Adama.)

Name: TID_MISSION_4_29_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: I was afraid of this. But thanks for making the trip, now we know.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_29
Text: I see dead people

Name: TID_MISSION_4_30_OBJECTIVE
Text: Take one of my men and get these batteries to Frank, he's in South Park Garden. We haven't heard from them for a while now, so I hope they too are just out of batteries. Trip there is dangerous, so I'll give you the best soldier I've got. Make sure he makes it back.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_30_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: (Note in his pocket says: if someone reads this, it's too late for us already. Save yourselves!)

Name: TID_MISSION_4_30_TASK_0
Text: Take batteries to Frank

Name: TID_MISSION_4_30
Text: No news...

Name: TID_MISSION_4_29_TASK_0
Text: Deliver the news to General Adama

Name: TID_MISSION_4_30_TALK_TASK_0
Text: Adama sent you? Good. I need some serious backup.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_31_OBJECTIVE
Text: I heard that there is a small group of new arrivals in Freedom Park. Can you believe that, in Freedom Park of all places! Will you go and see if they are OK?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_31_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Another survivor! Yay!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_31
Text: Survivors

Name: TID_MISSION_4_31_TASK_0
Text: Find the new arrivals

Name: TID_MISSION_4_32_OBJECTIVE
Text: We have to get the word out that there still are people alive here. Someone has to be looking for us. There are some barrels in the forest, will you go and light them for a signal before it's too late?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_32_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Thanks, lets hope that someone rescues us! I don't wanna end up like one of those brain chewing freaks!

Name: TID_MISSION_4_32_TASK_0
Text: Make some noise and fire

Name: TID_MISSION_4_32
Text: SOS

Name: TID_MISSION_4_33_OBJECTIVE
Text: Have you seen any gas canisters laying around? I need to get my car started. If you find any, I'll trade them for these useless Nanochips

Name: TID_MISSION_4_33_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: Damn! This is not enough! Now we have to wait for that SOS signal to work and by any means defend ourselves. There is no way I'm having my brains eaten ..

Name: TID_MISSION_4_33
Text: Gas off

Name: TID_MISSION_4_33_TASK_0
Text: Find gasoline

Name: TID_MISSION_4_34_OBJECTIVE
Text: You mean we should blow up all passageways and bunker ourselves in? Hmm. Well, if you're sure about it. I guess we will be saved by a helicopter anyway, so I guess it wont hurt. Can you do that?

Name: TID_MISSION_4_34_RECEIVING_MESSAGE
Text: This is great news, all we have to do is wait for rescue.

Name: TID_MISSION_4_34
Text: Seek and destroy

Name: TID_MISSION_4_34_TASK_0
Text: Empty bunkers
